verdict.rationale: Stable is an API-driven virtual mailbox and registered agent service. A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers API keys, x-api-key authentication, webhooks and location onboarding, but nothing mentions a sandbox, test mode or test keys isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
